payload.verifiable: All fourteen carry a named verify_method: R1-R10 and R12, Q1 by test; R11 by test plus inspection; D1 by demonstration, and D1 is deliberately the only one that cannot be automated - the card's rendering and the tap live on a device. Nothing was unnameable, so nothing was rewritten or dropped here.
payload.traced: No empty rows. R1 -> S1/prop 1. R2 -> S1/prop 2. R3 -> S2/prop 2. R4 -> S2/prop 2. R5 -> S3/prop 3. R6 -> S2 (a link that opens nothing is worse than none). R7 -> S6/the folded finding. R8 -> S4/prop 4. R9 -> S5/prop 5. R10 -> S5/prop 5. R11 -> prop 3 (the custodian's material includes their credentials). R12 -> S4/prop 4. Q1 -> prop 4 and the goal system's ruled priority that reaching the owner outranks richness. D1 -> S1 and S2, the two killers.
payload.functions_cover: Every requirement requires at least one of the fifteen functions, and every use-case step and extension maps to one - the full mapping is recorded at derive_functions. Two separations are deliberate and load-bearing: concealment (F4) apart from expiry (F7), because a system that conceals but never expires still leaves a readable archive for link-holders; and degrading (F12) apart from reporting (F13), because degrading silently is precisely the failure this iteration removes.
payload.set_holds: COMPLETE: every UC-A/B/C/D step and extension covered. CONSISTENT: one failure philosophy - degrade and record rather than block - with the single deliberate exception that an unservable page is never announced, which serves the same end of not misleading. AFFORDABLE: one transport module plus changes to the existing lane; the account, worker, namespace and token already exist and were re-verified BEFORE scoping, not assumed. BOUNDED: no editing decisions from the phone, no cone render, no second channel, no automated account setup. NO TBD. HONEST LIMIT, stated in the register rather than buried: R5 protects against the HOST, not against whoever holds the topic - link and key travel through a relay that retains for about twelve hours, which is the accepted-risk model already ruled, now extended to brief content.
payload.breaks_if_removed: Filled on all fourteen, each naming a concrete failure rather than a virtue: the tap erroring on a non-URL (R1); a gate indistinguishable from noise on a lock screen (R2); ntfy silently dropping the brief's link past three actions (R3); deciding on a truncated sentence (R4); ledger content in plaintext at a third party (R5); tapping into a 404 (R6); briefs accumulating as a readable archive (R7); a host outage becoming a gate outage (R8); either spamming the owner or - the failure that happened - reaching nobody (R9); a restored pairing doing nothing until the board is cycled (R10); a credential leaking into the record (R11); a broken lane indistinguishable from a quiet one (R12); an agent parking while believing the owner was reached (Q1); the unverified leg shipping unverified again (D1).
payload.assumptions_probed: Seven probed live against the real services, none deferred (run-bfd564ff9add): encryption leaves no plaintext; the store accepts an authenticated write with a bounded TTL; the read-after-write window is ~1s, MEASURED, which refines the design document's ~60s folklore while keeping the check required; the page serves as text/html so it renders rather than downloads; the stored object contains none of the brief's words; ntfy accepts the three-action card including a view link; and a gate's title, priority and tag survive the round trip. The one assumption that CANNOT be probed - how the card renders and whether the tap fires - is D1, and it is this iteration's own release gate rather than a claim.
